title: F155 pacing in the engine: one paced turn
caption: The reader takes the turn as fast as it comes; the writer hands the text out about thirty times a second at WordPace's pace, and a tool call goes out once the text before it has.

steps.text: Of(the turn's stream, the clock), STREAM_PACE on
the reader: every update, as fast as it comes
a burst of 300 letters, into the buffer
every 33 ms: Next(shown, arrived, since, done), continuous
how many letters may show now
a text update with the whole words that fit
the rest of the text first, then the tool call as it is
the last letters at the finishing pace, then the end
